items.text: UNDERSTANDING THATy= mX+CREPRESENTS A LINEAR RELATIONSHIP

items.text: Two variables have a linear relationship if they increase at a constant rate in relation to one another If you plot a graph with one such variable on the x-axis and the other on the y-axis, you get a straight line.
